policyChange.rationale: The 90-minute boundary truncated MAI Code 1.1 Flash runs before task completion. Version 1.1.0 applies a symmetric 120-minute limit to the full experiment matrix.

evidenceQualification.limitation: GitHub Copilot exposes the selected model IDs but not immutable provider model build IDs. Results are measured and reproducible at the disclosed Copilot model-selection and agent-version boundary, not at an underlying provider-build boundary.

efficient.notes: The exact Copilot model ID, agent version, and reasoning effort are pinned. Copilot does not expose an immutable provider model build ID or a separate agent build ID; the bounded-evidence limitation records that constraint.

frontier.notes: The exact Copilot model ID, agent version, and reasoning effort are pinned. Copilot does not expose an immutable provider model build ID or a separate agent build ID; the bounded-evidence limitation records that constraint.

executionPolicy.runOrderNotes: Execute the seeded order across lanes rather than grouping by model or treatment.
executionPolicy.queueAndThrottleNotes: Record queue and throttle time separately from productive execution time.
